name: Acolyte
text: This model gains the following action. **Chant** (AP 2): The gathering receives an additional mana dice of any type for its mana pool.

name: Balefire Body
text: If this model moves or is pushed over or through an enemy model, that model suffers 1 damage. An enemy model can only suffer this damage once per move or push action.

name: Breaking Wheel
text: If this model moves so that its base is touching an enemy model, that model suffers 2 damage. This model then suffers 1 damage. Only 1 enemy model can suffer this damage once per move activation.

name: Filthy or Shrouded
text: If this model is targeted by an attack/spell action from over 5" away it is deemed to be obscured (attacker receives a -1 to their violence/ranged roll) this bonus cannot stack with being obscured by terrain.

name: Fulminate
text: This model gains the following action. **Fulminate** (AP 1): Every model within 3" of this model also suffers 3 damage, this model is then Shattered. This model cannot be summoned after completing this action.

name: Fungal Bloom
text: On activation, you may choose a single model within 3" of this model, it suffers 1 damage.

name: Gnarled
text: Once per game, when this model is targeted by an attack action, the model receives +2 armour for the duration of that action.

name: Grafted or Many Limbed
text: On a single melee attack action per game, the model receives +1 attacks to 1 weapon it has.

name: Ineffable Dead
text: Reduce the distance this model is pushed by 1", to a minimum of 1".

name: Purloiner
text: After each scenario roll a d10, if this is equal or lower than this model's move characteristic, gain d10 obols.

name: Skitter
text: This model has +1 move, ignores falling damage if falling from 3" or lower. Falling damage still applies to any model it lands in base-to-base contact with.

name: Sluglike or Fleshy Amalgam
text: Movement up or down a vertical surface is counted as only half the distance in inches for this model. For example, a move of 4" up a vertical surface would be treated as only 2" of movement.

name: Voices from the Firmament
text: This model gains the following action. **Speak** (AP 1): Choose a single model within 5" and push it 1".
